title: Map Data Collection Form Builder: Field Forms
description: Build a field form with the Map Data Collection Form Builder — text, number and choice fields, GPS attached automatically, CSV or GeoJSON out. Free.
summary_sentence: Submissions use local browser storage when available; the form design resets on reload.
quick_answer: Design text, number and choice fields and save submissions in this browser. Device location is requested on submission and may be unavailable. CSV includes saved fields; GeoJSON contains only submissions with a position.

popular_table.note: Submissions persist in your browser's local storage on that device — they are not uploaded anywhere. That is the privacy bargain: nothing leaves the phone until you export the CSV or GeoJSON yourself.

faq: What happens if the browser closes mid-survey?
Saved submissions are restored if local storage is available, but the form design resets on reload. Export backups regularly; storage can fail or be cleared.
Can I edit the form after collecting some data?
Yes. CSV includes labels from older submissions as well as the current form, but old values may not appear in the on-page table after a field is renamed. Use unique labels and export backups.
How accurate is the automatic GPS?
The browser requests device location, which may be inaccurate, unavailable or denied. Submissions without a position are omitted from GeoJSON export.
CSV for spreadsheets and statistics; GeoJSON when the points must stay geographic — reopening in a GIS, a viewer, or a choropleth pipeline. Export both if unsure; they cost nothing.
This builder keeps to form fields and position — no photo upload. Note a photo filename or description in a text field if your workflow pairs camera shots with records.
No account quota exists; the practical limit is the browser's local storage on the device. For a long campaign, export regularly — exports are also your backup.
Can I predefine the area to survey?
Sketch the study area first with the Map Drawer or Pin Map Maker to brief collectors; the form itself happily records wherever the collector stands.
